To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
IT capability influences firm performance through SCI (i.e., both internal and external SCI).

the performance effects of IT capability differ depending on the type of IT capability (internally focused, externally focused, and IT business-spanning) and the type of supply chain integration (internal integration and external integration).
IT capability has a significant effect on firm performance through supply-chain integration, and IT business-spanning capability positively moderates IT capability’s effect on internal integration.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mediating effects of supply chain integration on the relationship between IT capability and firm performance.
the mediating role of SCI in the relationship between IT capability and firm performance.
the mediating effects of supply chain integration (i.e., both internal and external) and moderating effects of IT business spanning on the relationship between IT capability and firm performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

this research contributes to the literature of supply chain management, information technology management, and strategic management by providing insights into how IT capability influences firm performance through SCI, which is a critical mechanism in the IT-firm performance relationship.

this study contributes to the literature by investigating the mediating effects of supply chain integration on the relationship between IT capability and firm performance, and by providing insights on the moderating effect of IT business spanning on the relationship between internally-focused IT capability (iFIC) and internal integration (IINT).

IT business spanning capability has positive effects on firm performance through both internal and external integrations, and the positive effects of IT business spanning are stronger for firms with high internally-focused IT capability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
IT capability is an important source of competitive advantage for firms, and it can improve firms’ supply chain integration and performance.
IT capability has different effects on firm performance through different SCI.
the mediating and moderating effects of supply chain integration on the relationship between IT capability and firm performance are important and deserve more attention.
The main takeaway from our work is that
firms need to understand the mediating role of supply chain integration in the relationship between IT capability and firm performance.
IT capability can improve firm performance by enhancing SCI.
IT capability can be leveraged to improve supply chain integration and firm performance, and IT business-spanning capability plays an important role in this relationship.
